title: Runtime Closed Authority Boundary
scope: runtime adapter, boundary, analysis result, and query-policy consumers
operation identity, AST aliases, manifest, graph, IR, SDK, React, and CLI regression boundaries

results.name: runtime adapter returns the read-only DataFlowAuthorityInterface
results.detail: The downstream runtime surface is typed as closed authority, not producer execution algebra.

results.name: runtime adapter invokes the upstream judgment contract
results.detail: Semantic judgment is produced by the injected upstream authority.

results.name: runtime adapter does not expose fake seed execution
results.detail: A closed result is not misrepresented as an executable seed producer.

results.name: runtime adapter does not expose fake derive execution
results.detail: Downstream cannot request derivation that merely returns the same closed state.

results.name: runtime adapter does not expose fake close execution
results.detail: Downstream cannot request closure that merely returns the same closed state.

results.name: runtime adapter does not expose a judgment identity function
results.detail: The judge operation belongs to the upstream authority contract, not the downstream projection.

results.name: runtime adapter does not import the concrete solver
results.detail: Only upstream authority owns the solver binding.

results.name: runtime adapter preserves the exact upstream proof contract
results.detail: The projection forwards reasoning proof instead of minting or reconstructing it.

results.name: runtime adapter exposes the canonical closed judgment state
results.detail: Consumers receive the authoritative state and closed marker.

results.name: reachability query compares canonical semantic identities
results.detail: Query behavior uses the upstream identity contract rather than a local identity classifier.

results.name: runtime boundary projects to authority-only output
results.detail: The wiring contract separates upstream input from the read-only downstream authority.

results.name: analysis result exposes authority-only interface
results.detail: Analysis consumers cannot accidentally depend on producer-only methods.

results.name: state policy already consumes authority-only contract
results.detail: Policy queries are compatible with the narrower canonical runtime surface.

results.name: integration test reads fixed-point status from canonical state
results.detail: The test checks the state actually declared by the authority contract.

results.name: upstream authority remains the only solver binding
results.detail: The concrete solver is bound once in the upstream authority.

results.name: domain authority contract specializes shared reasoning judgment
results.detail: Dataflow uses the shared reasoning interface with canonical ADT input/output.

results.name: composition root selects the canonical upstream implementation
results.detail: Concrete authority selection stays in runtime composition, not in the adapter.

results.name: AST dataflow remains aliases of canonical ADTs
results.detail: No second AST-specific input or judgment model was introduced.

results.name: operation identity remains a separate canonical capability contract
results.detail: The change does not collapse route identity capability into dataflow semantics.

results.name: manifest projection forwards evidence rather than solving it
results.detail: Manifest remains a source/wiring surface, not a semantic solver.

results.name: IR projects canonical closed state
results.detail: IR consumes the completed closure.

results.name: structural graph retains its distinct relation projection
results.detail: Structural graph semantics remain distinct from runtime dataflow.

results.name: React, SDK, and CLI continue to consume endpoint capability contracts
results.detail: Downstream endpoint consumers are unchanged and do not reclassify identity.

results.name: semantic ownership coverage and prior audit chain remain present
results.detail: Focused checks extend rather than replace the ownership and prior-phase audits.

results.name: release/build contract remains unchanged
results.detail: The audit is reproducible without changing package version or build command.

decision.change: Expose DataFlowAuthorityInterface rather than DataFlowInterface from the closed semantic-dataflow runtime adapter.
decision.reason: The authority result is already closed upstream. Seed/derive/close methods that merely replay or return the same judgment falsely advertise producer execution capabilities and invite downstream misuse.
decision.preserved: The canonical upstream solver, semantic proof, closed judgment, identity-based reaches query, and composition root remain unchanged.
